name: Algorithm_1_graph_state_generation
title: Algorithm 1: graph state construction for Neo4j #14008
notes: Real running example: Neo4j issue #14008, https://github.com/neo4j/neo4j/issues/14008. Pattern P3, SY. N=300000; state_variant=pruning_path; data seed=0. Numbers inside nodes are uid values. The bracket repeats the two-hop GspMiddle-to-GspHigh motif N times, each connected to the same GspBad uid=0. All stored edges are directed GSP_LINK; all nodes except uid=0 have keep=true. Root uid=1 has id=1 and a GspLow(id) index. The valid witness is uid 1->2->3. There are 600004 nodes and 600003 relationships. G is a construction specification; conditions I and index readiness are verified after materialization. No reference region R is used for P3.

name: Algorithm_2_query_pair_construction
title: Algorithm 2: the real query pair from Neo4j #14008
notes: Source: https://github.com/neo4j/neo4j/issues/14008. This single P3 symmetry instance replaces the previous S7/P1 schematic examples. Q2 is derived from a copy of Q1 by mirroring the written undirected bounded path; the predicate and projection are unchanged. Both plans actually start at indexed u; the drawing shows query syntax, not physical traversal order. The graphical witnesses depict accepted paths, not physical expansion order; both plans start from indexed u. Black ticks mean keep=true on the witness node. The result table fixes the projection order u.uid, v.uid, hops despite reversed path order. The top patterns carry the relationship-type and path-bound substitutions; the lower left illustrates the L/H bindings. Runtime labels display the reported ordinary-runtime medians (2.70 ms and 530.10 ms) and common result (1,3,2) are reported for Neo4j 2026.09.0 / Cypher 25, not measurements rerun during this figure edit. The local generator with N=300000, seed=0, data_seed=0, complexity=0, state_variant=pruning_path produces this pair. This issue does not instantiate the short-circuit reference-substitution branch and uses no R region. Current GitHub API status: closed/completed 2026-10-15; contributor comment https://github.com/neo4j/neo4j/issues/14008#issuecomment-6190652273 says it should be fixed in 2026.10; that version was not independently tested here.
